北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有雾，请减速慢行，体感闷热，多补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is foggy, drive safely and stay hydrated in the muggy weather!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪大雨伴 7 级风，外出务必注意安全，带好雨具！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has heavy rain and strong winds; take an umbrella and stay safe!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云有 5 级风，体感舒适，记得添减衣物防着凉。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast with moderate wind, enjoy the comfortable weather, adjust clothing!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴热体感 34℃，紫外线强，注意防晒补水哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and feels like 34℃, strong UV, stay hydrated and use sunscreen!
广州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗温暖，体感 30℃，记得防晒，补充水分。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and warm, feels like 30℃, remember sunscreen and hydration.
深圳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州小雨伴 7 级风，外出带伞，体感较凉注意保暖。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has light rain and strong winds, take an umbrella and stay warm.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天有 5 级风，气温 30℃，注意防晒防风哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast with moderate wind and 30℃, protect from sun and wind.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都小雨伴 100% 湿度，体感潮湿，带好雨具别着凉。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu has light rain and 100% humidity, bring rain gear and don't catch a cold.
成都.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降8℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云炎热体感 36℃，注意防暑降温，多喝水。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and feels like 36℃, stay cool and hydrated!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天体感 32℃，气温较高，外出注意防晒哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast and feels like 32℃, it's hot, remember sun protection!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云体感 39℃！酷热难耐，务必防暑降温补水。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing feels like 39℃! It's extremely hot, stay cool and hydrated.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，体感 25℃，湿度较高，注意通风除湿。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy and feels like 25℃, high humidity, ensure ventilation.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳大雨伴 100% 湿度，出门带伞，路面湿滑慢行。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang has heavy rain and 100% humidity, take an umbrella, roads are slippery.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 23℃，湿度 88%，体感微凉别着凉。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast, feels like 23℃ with high humidity, stay warm.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天体感 31℃，气温较高，外出注意防晒哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast and feels like 31℃, it's hot, remember sun protection!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾伴 95% 湿度，出行注意交通安全，注意除湿。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy with high humidity, drive safely and dehumidify.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天伴 6 级风，体感较凉，外出注意防风保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is overcast with strong wind, feels cool, dress warmly and wind-proof.
